Interface Writable

  • All Superinterfaces:
    java.lang.AutoCloseable
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    ExcelWritable
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    AbstractWorkbook, AppendCSV, AppendWorkbook, WriteCSV, WriteWorkbook, WriteWorkbookStreaming

    public interface Writable
extends java.lang.AutoCloseable
    Defines the core contract for writing tabular data to a file.

    Implementations provide operations for managing row positions, inserting cell values, writing headers and content, and managing the underlying output resource.

    Implementations may require open() to be called before writing data. Resources should be released by calling close().
